crossRefs.note: Then Joshua spoke to Yahweh in the day when Yahweh delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel. He said in…
Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: four cities.
Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: four cities.
Out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Taanach with its pasture lands, and Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: two cities.
